name: Gorilla Shadow
summary: Gorilla Shadow is an exciting new take on the classic Gorilla Tag formula. In this fast-paced adventure, the playground is full of action and surprises. Explore vibrant, shadow-filled maps where speed, agility, and teamwork are key to staying ahead. Feel the thrill as you leap, swing, and strategize your next move to outplay others and master every environment.
